title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: Dat (Sony D8) -> VX Pocket 440 -> Sharp MV10 -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording of an energetic 1982 show featuring standout performances of Peggy‑O, Birdsong, Tennessee (T‑JED) and Sugaree.
ai_review.review: The SBD capture is praised for its clarity and strong drum mix, though a few listeners note it sounds a bit dry compared with audience recordings. Musically the concert shines with tight playing, Jerry’s soaring guitar and vocals, and memorable renditions of Peggy‑O, Birdsong, Tennessee (T‑JED), Deal, Sugaree and Stella Blue, while The Other One loses some steam toward the end.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show highly (5‑star) and describe it as energetic with many standout songs; recording is described as crisp and good, yielding an overall strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp and clear mix with excellent drum presence; some note the soundboard feels dry/sterile and lacks audience ambience, but no major technical flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set with tight playing; second set builds with a superb Sugaree and beautiful Stella Blue, though energy tapers slightly on The Other One.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for ‘on fire’ guitar work, strong vocals on Tennessee/T‑JED, unique riff on Sugaree, and memorable tone on Estimated.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as well‑balanced in the mix with a great drum/bass presence; generally solid bass performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals described as okay/slightly slurred by one reviewer but also highlighted for picking up nicely on Sugaree; shows a playful mood before Estimated.
band_member_comments.Drums: Great drum sound repeatedly mentioned, contributing to the crispness of the recording.
